title: FOOTBALL | Fluff Bothwell Press Conference - 11/27/26
text: All right, guys. We'll take questions for Fluff. Start with Steve. >> Fluff. It felt like you played with a lot of determination today to kind of lead this team to a win. Just kind of take me through your mindset. What were you thinking? And even on that last play, it's like you were looking for contact. Some might have run over. >> Uh just coming in as a team, uh knowing what this game means to our fans, the state. Uh just coming in, uh with the right mindset to dominate, execute, and uh just play one play at a time. Robbie, [snorts] >> it's another year where you're banged up and you're having to fight through it. I'm sure that's incredibly frustrating, but you know, what was it like going out there today and being able to to give it your all and have the production that you did individually to give your team a chance and there >> um I mean guy that makes no mistakes. I feel like everything happens for a reason and uh just him giving me the ability to go out there and play today was uh good. You know, I trust him. Uh just glad to be out back out there with the guys. uh especially the seniors for one last time. Uh just being able to play the game that I love. >> Sam, you announced your return for next season. Just what makes you believe in coach Levy and and where the program will be for next season? >> Uh just his vision and also the other guys around him. Uh really just the whole coaching staff. I mean it's all over the tape what we can do. Uh we just got to find the right pieces to do. James, >> just when it comes to that image that he has, how do you feel like that can help sell people on coming back to Mississippi State, but what you guys feel like will be a big 2027 season? >> Uh, I mean, everybody's seen it in the whole whole world. Uh, what we can do when we're healthy, uh, just like at the beginning season, I mean, really, we looked unstoppable and, uh, that's what it's going to be like next year for sure. Steve, >> along those lines, you know, you guys and coach Levby said it's been a tale of two seasons with Kamario and without, but when you think about what next year could be with you and Kamario and some other guys back. I mean, what are your thoughts about having one back in the huddle? >> Uh, it's going to be great. Uh, y'all seen what it looks like when he's out there and we're going to have him back for sure. along those lines as well. What are you telling guys who maybe are wavering or then you know with recruiting coming up telling guys who are coming to visit come be a part of this next year? >> Uh just like I said uh everybody sees it. Uh I mean first of all there's no place like Starville but uh other than that I mean the coach the coach lives I mean he constantly puts in our head like what it's going to look like, what it's going to be and what it is. And so, uh, just having a truthful coach tell you what's right and what's wrong and, uh, just seeing the vision for next year. >> Sam, >> what do you just think of the way that Billy was able to step up in a difficult situation these last two months and making three stars and playing a lot of QB? >> Uh, just constantly telling him, trust himself. Uh, I mean, can't nobody write his story by him and, uh, just trusting himself, you know, uh, lifting that guy and having the whole team behind him and, uh, no matter what happens, just putting his play. >> You spoke a little bit about having [snorts] the confidence to bounce back from injury this year that maybe you didn't have last year. How else do you feel like you've changed as a player, person over the course of the last few years? >> Uh, just growing the the knowledge of football, not just playing it, uh, knowing what's going on. uh the situation [clears throat] and uh you know just having you know the medical staff, our staff uh just behind me pushing me uh let me know everything going to be okay and you know just take one day at a time. >> Anything else for Fluff? All right. Thanks guys.
